QuestInfo.name: Henesys, Here I Come!
QuestInfo.0: Grendel the Really Old has someone to introduce to you... Who could it be?\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You met Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You decided to stay in Henesys for a while and get used to life in Maple World.

0.0: I know someone who will help you get settled in Henesys.\rGood luck there.

no.0: I'll guide you to someone who will help you, so talk to me when you're ready.

1.0: Hello, #h0#. I've heard a lot about you from Grendel the Really Old. My name is Athena Pierce, and I am the Bowman Instructor here in Henesys. Nice to meet you.

yes.0: I can assure you Henesys is one of the safest towns in Maple World. This would be a good place to stay until you find your feet again.\r\n\r\nLeave through the portal on the right and let Camila guide you through Henesys. Good luck on your journey.
